title: Bell as a thorium-mercury overunity power device

tellings.quote: So so it was a overunity device where you would be putting a certain amount of energy into it both AC and DC but then the nuclear reaction of the thorium

plain: The Bell, a device said to have been built in secret for Nazi Germany at the Skoda Works near Prague between 1937 and 1944, was really an "overunity" power machine, giving out more energy than went into it. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this came from an unnamed elderly source in Serbia, who said that both AC and DC current were fed in, and that a nuclear reaction in thorium and mercury did the rest.
